::: {.callout-note}
## Category Overview & Scope
컴퓨터비전의 시각적 표현 학습(Visual Representation Learning)을 주도해 온 주요 백본 네트워크들을 다룹니다.

* **Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN):** AlexNet, VGG, ResNet, EfficientNet, ConvNeXt
* **Vision Transformers (ViT):** Standard ViT, Swin Transformer, DeiT, PVT
* **Self-Supervised Learning (SSL):** MoCo, SimCLR, DINO, DINOv2, MAE (Masked Autoencoders)
* **Next-Gen Architectures:** Vision Mamba (SSM), RWKV-Vision, State Space Models
:::
